title: Validation & Analytics Engine V1.3 — Analysis Specification

decision_rules.qc_failed: Do not issue final inferential interpretation.
decision_rules.material_missingness: Run registered sensitivity analysis or mark result LIMITED/NOT_ESTIMABLE.
decision_rules.assumptions_failed: Use an appropriate alternative model or mark INVALID/NOT_ESTIMABLE; record rationale.
decision_rules.effect_size_without_ci: Allowed only for descriptive outputs where CI is not estimable; otherwise QC warning.
decision_rules.claim_status: Claim level cannot exceed the strongest provenance-supported level.
decision_rules.evidence_status: No automatic promotion from MDL/HYP/RPT/DRV to EVD.
